description: Suggest accounts from work email domains that several contacts share (for example 7 contacts at acme.com). Personal and disposable providers (gmail.com, outlook.com, yopmail.com, ...), the workspace's own sending domains, domains where any contact already belongs to an account, and domains an account already uses are skipped. Each suggestion includes up to 10 sampleEmails for review. Read-only; show the list to the user and accept only the domains they confirm with accept_account_suggestions.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

minContacts.description: Contacts a domain needs to be suggested (default 3, min 2).

name: list_account_suggestions

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_account_suggestions` MCP tool.

suggestions.description: Suggested accounts, largest first, each with domain, name, contactCount and up to 10 sampleEmails.
